pass_scope: Final matching offline source, 20 compiled-player cases validated across combined runs, host DOM/crypto/import 12/12 (child animation frames held), seven CPU suites and staged visual 8/8 checks, with root visual review. Strict archive reconstruction and extracted browser BOOT are recorded separately after sealing; native .46 acceptance remains pending. Every selected earlier case and its helper dependencies are AST-identical to the final case; the final revision adds only a bounded wait for the actual native resize event before the unchanged assertion. Every originally failed, not-completed or changed case passed a fresh retry, and both earlier resize failures are preserved. This is not a single clean 20-case execution of the final harness. Actual compiled opaque iframe/WebGL, synthetic parent/clock; same-task canvas PNGs plus real DOM bounds, not full-page UI screenshots. No native Safari/device performance claim.

host.scope: Deterministic offline host DOM, native WebCrypto, synthetic account/fetch fixtures, postMessage and file import/export checks. Child requestAnimationFrame callbacks are held before child code runs; top-level host animation frames remain active. Fetched compiled HTML bytes and digest are unchanged. Rendering and gameplay are checked separately by the compiled-player and visual suites.

visual_rig.scope: Actual unmodified renderer/world in an offline camera rig; staged camera and character positions; not player/UI/gameplay verification.

comparison_budgets.note: Actual submitted triangles include shadow passes; these are workload counts, not native frame-rate measurements.

review_notes: Root visually inspected all eight final unaltered canvas PNGs; lighthouse and cast views were also independently inspected by the lighting reviewer.
Faces have modeled sockets, eyelids, noses, lips and ears; clothing panels now shade smoothly and hands have defined fingers. The result remains stylized 3D art.
Worn sandy routes, muted turf and sparse grass replace uniform story-island green slabs; coast edges and nearby foam read at the normal pier camera.
First-pass shadow grid on ground, paving and character details is absent after restoring the proven depth/normal bias offsets.
Both staged walking poses retain the prior silhouette, foot motion and separate crew; normal camera and portrait Low views remain readable.
The lighthouse beam is softer and less solid; warm lanterns and cool dusk remain distinct.
All eight embedded textures loaded with no GL, console or page errors and no attempted network requests.
Native iPad Safari appearance and sustained performance of .46 remain pending; .45 smoothness was user-reported and is not an FPS measurement.
